description: This file defines the DynamoDbStreamsClient class which provides methods to interact with Amazon DynamoDb Streams service, including operations like describeStream, getRecords, getShardIterator, and listStreams. It extends the AwsClient class and specifies default retry configurations.

classes.name: DynamoDbStreamsClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon DynamoDb Streams, providing methods for stream operations and extending the general AwsClient.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Overrides the parent getArguments method to set default retry configurations for DynamoDbStreamsClient.
